title: Controlled vs Uncontrolled State Synchronization & Custom Hooks
subtopicTitle: Controlled vs Uncontrolled State Synchronization & Custom Hooks
problemStatement:
Designing dual-mode components supporting both uncontrolled (defaultValue) and controlled (value + onChange) with zero glitches.

**Enterprise Importance**:
Design system components must work seamlessly in both simple uncontrolled forms and complex controlled state management libraries like React Hook Form.
interviewTrap: Switching from uncontrolled to controlled during component lifecycle, triggering React warnings and unexpected state resets.

detailedExplanation.conceptualOverview: Use a custom hook (`useControllableState`) that checks whether `value !== undefined`. If controlled, reflect the prop; if uncontrolled, maintain internal state.
stepByStepWalkthrough: 1. Design Token Layer: Primitives, semantic aliases, and component tokens established.
2. Component Architecture: Headless state and keyboard accessibility hooks implemented.
3. Styling & Cascade: Zero-runtime CSS variables and layer specificity managed.
4. Governance & Packaging: Tree-shaking, semantic versioning, and telemetry monitored.
